source.usedFor: ordem dos beats, ações e ritmo dos cortes

productionMethod.anchorGeneration: local Wan2GP T2V; an AI-generated local frame is extracted as the I2V start image
productionMethod.motionGeneration: local Wan2GP Fun InP 1.3B through the native queue
editorialCodeAllowedFor: frame extraction from the AI-generated anchor clip

replan.trigger: two Nexus T2V prompts retained crochet on the focal textile but left another surface smooth and failed to show the intended horizontal contact clearly
replan.change: separate anchor composition from action; use a simpler all-crochet macro image and animate one action with Fun InP I2V

anchorAttempt01.finding: AI anchor shows a smooth wooden counter and window beyond the crochet mat; the first frame has no scrubber/hand yet

replan.anchorAttempt02Correction: overhead close crop; crochet mat fills all four frame edges; remove room, window, wood and hand so the anchor contains only stable crocheted materials

anchorAttempt02.finding: the frame removed the room background but the model rendered the focal dish with a smooth rigid white rim and exposed a pale smooth surface at the bottom edge

anchorAttempt03.finding: macro bowl and scrubber were visibly crochet, but the model left smooth wooden strips at both the top and bottom frame edges

replan.replanAfterRepeatedMaterialDrift: keep the beat's scrubbing action but replace the bowl-shaped object with a flat crocheted dish-drying mat; a flat textile has fewer hard-object priors for this local checkpoint
replan.anchorAttempt04Correction: remove all rigid dishware from the composition; use only two crochet textiles and one scrub pad under an overhead edge-to-edge crop

generationStrategy.phase: one proof action before any full batch

anchor.selectionStatus: attempts 01 through 03 rejected; attempt 04 pending generation and visual inspection

proof.action: one short left-to-right scrub pass with continuous physical contact on a crocheted dish-drying mat
acceptance: every visible solid surface remains clearly crocheted with stable loop scale in every sampled frame
the pad moves horizontally once, keeps contact, and does not dip vertically or float
crochet drying mat, scrub pad, hand and layout keep stable identity and shape
vertical macro reads at phone scale without extra props or distractions
no P0/P1 finding remains after actual motion playback and 10 fps inspection

audio.soundDesign: existing sound-design.json remains a plan only; foley is aligned after visual acceptance

runBoundary.nextGate: inspect the AI-generated anchor, run one Fun InP I2V proof, then perform professional QA before expanding

creatorReview.firstAestheticReview: actual Fun InP proof clip after professional QA
